mods.title: Aluwerk
mods.author: Dr Bruno & Syrusate
mods.description: A true concept-mod with a metallic look and sound, highly appealing to producers of industrial music.

mods.title: AnokhaV2
mods.author: Sam Laleo Singh
mods.description: Features sitar loops, tabla samples, and a graphical interface decorated with Indian deities to create a definite ethnic vibe.

mods.title: Bone Vibes
mods.author: Syrusate
mods.description: A black and dark mod with lots of rattling bones and skulls (including an 808 drum selection knob), suited for industrial and darkwave.

mods.title: Circuit
mods.author: Epilogue
mods.description: Has a green glowing electric look and features a collection of industrial-type basses and snares.

mods.title: Digalog
mods.author: Einzelgänger
mods.description: Features a very plastic blue interface with highly electronic, synthetic percussion sounds and bleeps.

mods.title: ibex mkII
mods.author: Unknown
mods.description: Contains a very varied set of sounds, ranging from a tribal didgeridoo to assorted synths and full drums.

mods.title: iCE!
mods.author: Entropy/SiNGULARiTY
mods.description: Described directly by the author as 'chilly and cheezy' with many original sounds left intact.

mods.title: Infernalizer
mods.author: Jesuspark
mods.description: Hailed historically as 'The Most Beautiful Mod Ever,' it features sharp drums, synths, and a church organ tailored for dark or loud styles.

mods.title: IQ
mods.author: Dr. Bruno & Syrusate
mods.description: A funky, collaborative mod from the same creators of the Aluwerk mod.

mods.title: Manic Box
mods.author: DJ LuVcHiLE
mods.description: A mean, black interface packed with phat percussion sounds tailored for tribal-minded producers.

mods.title: Metallicon
mods.author: Propellerhead
mods.description: One of the four official default mods included on the original ReBirth 2.0.1 CD-ROM.

mods.title: minimod
mods.author: Peff
mods.description: A house producer's toolbox featuring house organs, basses, pianos, and a beautifully crafted GUI that mimics a classic synth brand.

mods.title: Modulus
mods.author: Tristan
mods.description: Bread-and-butter clean drums mapped to the 909, and wacky FX and brass stabs mapped to the 808.

mods.title: Noize
mods.author: Einzelgänger
mods.description: A minimalistic, futuristic interface with electro/plastic sounds that follow a similar design philosophy to the Digalog mod.

mods.title: Polyvibe
mods.author: Jonas H.
mods.description: An Acid Jazz mod featuring pianos, brass, jazzy drums, and a blend of blue-note samples.

mods.title: Red Stripe
mods.author: Thomas & Wolfgang Merkle
mods.description: An official branding campaign mod created through UK agency 5emedia; requires transport at 338 BPM for fast drum roll effects.

mods.title: X-Anvers
mods.author: Unknown
mods.description: A house-style mod featuring pads and synth bleeps that react beautifully to the Pattern Controlled Filter.
